question: Is the RERA registration number verified for every listing?
answer: Yes, every under-construction and newly-built property on NCR Estates displays its RERA registration number, verified against the respective state RERA authority records.

question: Do I need to pay brokerage to use NCR Estates?
answer: Browsing, saving properties, and contacting agents is completely free. Brokerage, where applicable, is disclosed upfront by the listing agent before any agreement.

question: How accurate is the EMI calculator?
answer: Our EMI calculator uses the standard reducing-balance formula based on the loan amount, interest rate, and tenure you enter. Actual bank offers may vary slightly based on your credit profile.

question: Can I schedule a site visit before making an inquiry?
answer: Absolutely — use the inquiry form on any property page or tap the WhatsApp button to message the listing agent directly and arrange a convenient time.

question: How do I compare multiple properties?
answer: Tap the compare icon on any property card (up to 3 at a time) — a comparison bar appears at the bottom of the screen letting you view them side-by-side.
